  Release-worthy (requires release notes below the `---`):

    feat!:   breaking new feature          → major version bump (v2.2.0 → v3.0.0)
    fix!:    breaking bug fix              → major version bump (v2.2.0 → v3.0.0)

  Non-release (release notes not required):
    chore:     housekeeping / no user impact
    docs:      documentation only
    ci:        CI / workflow changes
    build:     build system changes
    refactor:  internal refactor, no behavior change
    perf:      performance improvement
    style:     formatting / whitespace
    test:      test-only changes
    revert:    reverts a previous commit

  An optional scope in parentheses is allowed, e.g. `feat(ka): add cover page`.

  Examples:
    feat: add statutory declaration toggle
    fix: correct glossary ordering
    feat!: rename `include-ai-declaration` to `ai-declaration`
    chore: bump CI runner to ubuntu-24.04
    docs: clarify getting-started section
